name: MDLIVE
one_liner: Video therapy and psychiatry appointments with US-licensed clinicians, billed to insurance or paid per visit; owned by Cigna's Evernorth.
best_for: Adults and children 10+ who want scheduled video therapy, including evenings and weekends
People with Cigna, Humana, Blue Cross Blue Shield or other participating plans
People who need a psychiatrist for non-controlled medications
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who need stimulants, benzodiazepines or other controlled medications
People who need disability paperwork or emotional support animal letters
short_description: Per-visit telehealth therapy and psychiatry across the US and Puerto Rico; up to $179 for a first therapy visit and $299 for a first psychiatry visit.
long_description: MDLIVE, part of Cigna's Evernorth, offers scheduled video appointments with licensed therapists (typically 45–60 minutes) and board-certified psychiatrists (typically 15–30 minutes) for people aged 10 and up, anywhere in the US and Puerto Rico; phone visits depend on state rules. You choose your provider and can switch at any time. Before insurance, therapy costs up to $179 for the first visit and $140 for follow-ups, and psychiatry up to $299 for the first visit and $159 for follow-ups; copays on participating plans can be as low as $0. Psychiatrists do not prescribe controlled substances such as stimulants or anti-anxiety drugs. There is a $50 fee for cancelling within 24 hours. MDLIVE's privacy policy says it may share website identifiers and activity for advertising; in 2026 it agreed to a $3.5 million class-action settlement over tracking on its patient portal, without admitting wrongdoing. We found no published study of MDLIVE's behavioral health service.
patient_summary: You create an account, pick a licensed therapist or psychiatrist, and book a video visit, including nights and weekends. With insurance you may pay as little as a $0 copay; before insurance a first therapy visit is up to $179 and follow-ups $140, and psychiatry is up to $299 then $159. Psychiatrists can prescribe some medications, but not controlled substances.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance; $179 first therapy visit then $140/session before insurance
pricing.notes: Psychiatry: up to $299 first visit, $159 follow-up before insurance. Copays on participating plans can be $0. $50 fee for cancelling within 24 hours (not for Medicare or Medicaid members).

privacy.notes: Visit records are PHI handled as a HIPAA business associate, but the policy says website identifiers and activity may be 'shared' for advertising; a 2026 private class action over portal tracking settled for $3.5 million.

seo.title: MDLIVE: 24/7 Telehealth Psychiatry & Therapy | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: MDLIVE provides video psychiatry and therapy appointments, often available within 24 hours, covered by most major insurance plans.

faqs.q: How much does MDLIVE psychiatry cost?
faqs.a: With insurance, MDLIVE psychiatry visits typically cost $0-75 copay depending on your plan. Cigna members often have $0 copays. Without insurance, psychiatry visits are $284 and therapy is $108-129. Check your plan's telehealth benefits for exact costs.

Yes, MDLIVE psychiatrists can prescribe anxiety medications including SSRIs, SNRIs, buspirone, and in some cases benzodiazepines. Controlled substance prescribing follows DEA telehealth rules and varies by state. Initial visits include a thorough psychiatric evaluation.

faqs.q: How quickly can I get an MDLIVE psychiatry appointment?
faqs.a: MDLIVE psychiatry appointments are typically available within 24-48 hours, significantly faster than traditional in-person psychiatry wait times of 4-8 weeks. Some same-day appointments available. Therapy appointments also have quick availability.

Yes, MDLIVE is owned by Evernorth, which is Cigna's health services company. Cigna members often have MDLIVE included in their benefits with $0 copays for behavioral health. But MDLIVE also accepts most other major insurance plans.

primary_uses: Video therapy with a licensed therapist
Psychiatric evaluation and non-controlled medication management
Care for children and teens aged 10–17

availability.note: Ages 10 and up, anywhere in the US and Puerto Rico; phone visits vary by state. English and Spanish.
